sloka: शूलो ऽयं वज्रसारस्ते राम रोषान्मयोद्यतः ।तव भ्रातृसहायस्य सद्यः प्राणान् हरिष्यति ।। ६.१०४.१८ ।।
transliteration: śūlo 'yaṁ vajrasāraste rāma roṣānmayodyataḥ ।tava bhrātṛsahāyasya sadyaḥ prāṇān hariṣyati ।। 6.104.18 ।।

translations.english: "O Rama! This thunderbolt like trident taken up by me now will take away your life along with your brother's."
